mapper.select: SELECT c.id, c.parent_id, c.name, c.level, c.sort, CASE c.status WHEN 1 THEN 'ENABLED' ELSE 'DISABLED' END AS status, COUNT(a.id) AS article_count FROM category c LEFT JOIN article a ON a.category_id = c.id AND a.deleted = 0 WHERE c.deleted = 0 GROUP BY c.id, c.parent_id, c.name, c.level, c.sort, c.status ORDER BY c.level ASC, c.sort ASC, c.id ASC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM category WHERE parent_id = #{parentId} AND deleted = 0
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM article WHERE category_id = #{categoryId} AND deleted = 0
mapper.update: UPDATE category SET sort = #{sort}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
